invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of add(new Label(...)), and neither add nor the Label constructor is expected to return null under normal circumstances.
The cell returned always contains a Label instance, as the method specifically adds a new Label.
The text field passed in is used as the Label constructor argument, so the Label contained in the result should have getText() equal to text.
If text or Label.getText() is null, attempting to check equals directly could throw; this covers safe equality.
The created Label is constructed with the skin field, so its getSkin() result should be the same as the skin at this point.
